findings: All 28 pre-existing perturbations were rerun. The 27 in-scope inputs remain strictly equivalent. The sole mismatch is review4_chrome_visible_physical_font, which account 5d3ad9ad explicitly excludes and this review neither counts as a pass nor uses as a rejection.

All ten retained review5_ sources are valid PlantUML SEQUENCE diagrams. Their Java SVGs are well-formed and contain no PlantUML error markers. Two draft same-y probes were rejected by Java during fixture construction and were corrected before comparison; no invalid source or error SVG remains in the review artifacts.
Four of ten fresh heldouts pass: prefixed/suffixed required-zero formats through stop/resume, FROM_LEFT depths 0-3, TO_LEFT depths 3-0, and TO_RIGHT depths 3-0.
Six of ten fresh heldouts fail, with independent counterexamples in every claimed mechanism cluster.

Half-head direction now swaps semantic participants, but decoration composition is incomplete. parse_arrow records source_cross for reverse slash/backslash tokens; both straight half-arrow branches call message_half_arrow with only an optional source circle. Java CommandArrow applies cross ownership and ArrowPart independently, so valid /-x, \-x, //-x, and \\-x forms require both primitives.

The autonumber parser now preserves literal angle text, but format_autonumber searches only for the first 0 and consumes only a following zero run. Java DecimalFormat consumes the entire ##0 placeholder. The valid resumed pattern therefore leaks literal ## in Rust.

The live-depth endpoint formula generalizes for the fresh left ascent and both outgoing depth descents. It does not generalize to an isolated FROM_RIGHT staircase: Rust computes a shared right envelope five pixels narrower than Java at every depth and propagates it to a following TO_RIGHT message.

The new live_depth_at_message_ordinate helper changes endpoint depth, but the fresh valid same-ordinate activation sequences show that Rust's underlying event timeline still differs. Java retains an additional 30px nested activation segment and row; Rust emits a zero-height nested bar and shifts every later message one row upward on both borders.

Mechanical anti-overfit searches found no golden or fixture reads, review5 labels, coordinate-keyed or label-keyed conditions, source-line gates, collection-count ladders, or unexplained parity constants. The only added decimal literals are neutral 0.0 branches. git diff --check is clean.
No Cargo, rustc, rustfmt, production gate, or implementation-authored unit test was used as checker evidence.
